description: [Ncloud Storage] Get an object's metadata without downloading it (HEAD /{key}): size, type, ETag, storage class, version ID, restore status and Object Lock retention / legal hold. Returns exists=false on 404 (object missing, or its current version is a delete marker on a versioned bucket) instead of an error.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

versionId.description: Version ID of the object (versioning-enabled buckets). Omit for the current version

name: ncloud_ncs_head_object
